raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

MUSA exposes the portable
`get_device_module().is_current_stream_capturing()` API, but the breakable CUDA
graph capture-status helper does not include MUSA in that portable branch. MUSA
therefore falls through to the NVIDIA-only cuda-python path and fails even
though the portable capture-status query is available.

## Modifications

- Include MUSA in the portable capture-status branch of
  `_is_stream_capturing()`.
- Keep the original cuda-python path for NVIDIA.
- Add a focused unit test that verifies MUSA calls the portable device API and
  never reaches the CUDA bindings path.

## Related Work

- MUSA roadmap: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/16565
- MUSA PCG reference: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/20758

The PCG reference is platform context only; this PR fixes breakable graph capture
status and does not depend on the PCG implementation.

## Accuracy Test

Dispatch-level A/B verification with a mocked portable device module:

```text
torch.musa.is_current_stream_capturing callable: True
torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing callable: True

stock SGLang: STOCK_USED_CUDA_BINDINGS_PATH
patched SGLang: True
patched portable calls: 1
```

This confirms the issue is dispatch, not missing MUSA capture capability. The
stock branch reaches the NVIDIA cuda-python path; the patched branch calls the
portable MUSA API exactly once.

`pre-commit` passed on both changed files. Python compilation and
`git diff --check` also passed.

The test environment exposes a MUSA device, but no physical MUSA Graph capture
or breakable model run was completed. End-to-end MUSA availability and breakable
prefill performance remain separate validation work.

@@ -38,7 +38,7 @@
 from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner_backend_utils.breakable_cuda_graph.cuda_utils import (
     checkCudaErrors,
 )
-from sglang.srt.utils import get_device_module, is_hip, is_xpu
+from sglang.srt.utils import get_device_module, is_hip, is_musa, is_xpu
 
 _is_xpu = is_xpu()
 
@@ -88,11 +88,11 @@ def _capture_status(stream_ptr: int) -> "rt.cudaStreamCaptureStatus":
 
 
 def _is_stream_capturing(stream: torch.Stream) -> bool:
-    # On ROCm/HIP and XPU, cuda-python is unavailable, so use the portable torch
-    # API (which maps to the HIP / XPU runtime). On NVIDIA, keep querying the
-    # CUDA runtime directly via cuda-python: torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing()
-    # has proven unreliable there, so we preserve the original behavior.
-    if is_hip() or _is_xpu:
+    # On ROCm/HIP, MUSA, and XPU, cuda-python is unavailable or unnecessary, so
+    # use the portable device API. On NVIDIA, keep querying the CUDA runtime
+    # directly via cuda-python because torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing()
+    # has proven unreliable there.
+    if is_hip() or is_musa() or _is_xpu:
         with get_device_module().stream(stream):
             return get_device_module().is_current_stream_capturing()
     return (

+# ==============================================================================
+
+import sys
+from contextlib import nullcontext
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import pytest
+
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner_backend_utils.breakable_cuda_graph import (
+    breakable_cuda_graph,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=1, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+def test_musa_uses_portable_stream_capture_status() -> None:
+    stream = object()
+    device_module = SimpleNamespace(
+        stream=lambda value: nullcontext(),
+        is_current_stream_capturing=lambda: True,
+    )
+
+    with (
+        patch.object(breakable_cuda_graph, "is_hip", return_value=False),
+        patch.object(breakable_cuda_graph, "is_musa", return_value=True),
+        patch.object(breakable_cuda_graph, "_is_xpu", False),
+        patch.object(
+            breakable_cuda_graph, "get_device_module", return_value=device_module
+        ),
+    ):
+        assert breakable_cuda_graph._is_stream_capturing(stream)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v"]))
